outcome: oxytocin receptor (OXTR) expression in myometrial tissue
prostaglandin (FP) receptor expression in myometrial tissue
cohort: The study included 73 pregnant individuals with a singleton gestation undergoing scheduled cesarean delivery at term, comprising 49 individuals with a pre-pregnancy BMI >= 30 kg/m^2 and 24 with BMI < 25.0 kg/m^2.
finding: Spontaneous and oxytocin-stimulated myometrial contraction frequency, duration, and force, as well as OXTR gene and protein expression, did not significantly differ between obese and normal-weight individuals, though FP gene expression was lower in the obese group while protein expression did not differ.
cross-section timing: At scheduled cesarean delivery at term
